_what_this_is: THE RATCHET. Protected, so only the human maintenance lane can move these numbers. scripts/factory_evidence.py parse_harness asserts observed >= floor for static_checks, unit_tests, holdout_assertions, mutations_total and, when present here, mutations_independent_caught and mutations_security_caught. It reads the floors from origin/main, not from the PR head, so a PR cannot lower the bar it is judged against. There is no separate program asserting floor(head) >= floor(base); an earlier version of this note claimed one. The protection of this file by the security guard and the immunity registry's json_number_min assertions are what stop a floor going down (FACTORY_RULES section 13).
_slack_is_zero_here_on_purpose: Measured floors should be set equal to what the harness observes, not below it. For new structural floors, the committed catalogue itself can justify a higher acceptance threshold before the first VPS observation: if the environment cannot clear it, the gate stays red rather than silently accepting the older baseline.
